name: gridprims
description: The US power grid's math, files, and public data in one free tab.

scripts.test: GRIDPRIMS_DIST=$(node verify/prebuild.mjs) && export GRIDPRIMS_DIST && node --test --test-force-exit "verify/tests/{core,gates,intake,mcp,parsers,pipeline,site,tools}/**/*.test.mjs" && node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 "verify/tests/browser/*.test.mjs"
